text: ひとの　ポケモン　みると　つい　ぬすみたく　なっちゃうんでさ！

structure.jp: ひとの　ポケモン　みると
structure.en: when I see other people's Pokémon

structure.jp: つい　ぬすみたく　なっちゃうんでさ！
structure.en: I just end up wanting to steal them, you see!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the casual short form of てしまう, which says something happens without you meaning it to. なっちゃう = 'I end up becoming'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever that happens, this follows'. みると = 'when I see them'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means wanting to do it; it changes to たく before なる, 'to become'. ぬすみたく なっちゃう = 'I end up wanting to steal'.
